physicalEvidence.status: 2024 collaborative learned path-planner execution on real JetRacer; current Citadel apparatus unverified
physicalEvidence.summary: Full December 2024 SmartBSP trains a CNN actor-critic with PPO to select local B-spline control points from limited lidar grids. Section V executes the learned planner on a real JetRacer with Jetson Nano, lidar and odometry/EKF, navigating two obstacle layouts. A classical PID tracks waypoints at constant forward speed. The training setup explicitly ignores state transitions, so this is not evidence of a general long-horizon RL policy. Coauthors are at UNH and Citadel; the paper does not establish current Citadel ownership of the robot, so collaborative physical credit is capped at 20.
